attributes.rationale: Convex provides three function types with specific use cases: queries for reading data, mutations for writing data, and actions for complex operations requiring Node.js built-ins
attributes.query_pattern: Use query() for read operations with ctx.db for database access
attributes.mutation_pattern: Use mutation() for write operations with ctx.db.insert/patch/replace/delete
attributes.action_pattern: Use action() for Node.js built-ins, fetch, and cross-runtime calls with 'use node' directive
